sql.label: file_assets
sql.query: SELECT CASE WHEN id::text LIKE 'c0f0%' THEN id::text ELSE '<NEW-ID>' END, COALESCE(issue_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(page_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(project_id::text, 'NULL'), entity_type, size::text, is_uploaded, COALESCE(created_by_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(updated_by_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(deleted_at::text, 'NULL'), asset, attributes::text, COALESCE(storage_metadata::text, 'NULL') FROM file_assets ORDER BY regexp_replace(asset, '[0-9a-f]{32}', '<HEX>'), id::text LIKE 'c0f0%' DESC

sql.label: pages
sql.query: SELECT id::text, regexp_replace(description_html, 'src="(?!c0f0)[0-9a-f-]{36}"', 'src="<NEW>"', 'g'), COALESCE(description_stripped, 'NULL'), description_json::text, encode(description_binary, 'escape'), COALESCE(created_by_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(updated_by_id::text, 'NULL') FROM pages ORDER BY id

sql.label: issues
sql.query: SELECT id::text, regexp_replace(description_html, 'src="(?!c0f0)[0-9a-f-]{36}"', 'src="<NEW>"', 'g'), COALESCE(description_stripped, 'NULL'), state_id::text, COALESCE(completed_at::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(created_by_id::text, 'NULL'), COALESCE(updated_by_id::text, 'NULL') FROM issues ORDER BY id
